description: A secret as a QUOTED KEY in a JSON config, the shape an escape hunt produced that the rule could not read: the closing quote of the key sat between the credential word and the colon, and the regex demanded the colon immediately. Quoted keys are how real leaks travel -- config.json and docker env files -- so the rule now accepts a consenting pair of quotes around the name. Measured: zero new matches on 691 files of live repository code.
